schema.name: occurrence_id
schema.description: The sighting this diagnosis was written against. A record can outlive its occurrence: a retried sweep mints fresh occurrence ids.

schema.name: edits
schema.description: Proposed replacements, each a path, a line range, the anchored code and its replacement. JSON rather than a REPEATED RECORD, as rubrics is, so the edit shape can evolve without a schema migration.
